name: AI Inference
description: Generate an AI response based on a provided prompt

prompt-file.description: Path to a file containing the prompt (supports .txt and .prompt.yml formats)

input.description: Template variables in YAML format for .prompt.yml files

file_input.description: Template variables in YAML format mapping variable names to file paths. The file contents will be used for templating.

system-prompt.description: The system prompt for the model

system-prompt-file.description: Path to a file containing the system prompt

max-tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate

enable-github-mcp.description: Enable Model Context Protocol integration with GitHub tools

github-mcp-token.description: The token to use for GitHub MCP server (defaults to GITHUB_TOKEN if not specified)
